title: Lab Report
description: Lab Report contract normalized from the DocuBricks Healthcare library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-healthcare-lab-report
  title: Lab Report
  description: Lab Report contract normalized from the DocuBricks Healthcare library.
  version: healthcare_lab_report_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: healthcare/lab_report
    sourcePath: Schemas/healthcare/lab_report
    sourceVersion: healthcare_lab_report_v1
    sourceDigest: dc9708bb00b29db0f51b7fb77f934e41bee606f0ceb9c5f937dc1c280825f30c
spec:
  documentType: lab_report
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - collection-date
        - received-date
        - report-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - clinical-notes
        - flag
        - lab-clia-number
        - loinc-code
        - ordering-provider-npi
        - patient-dob
        - patient-mrn
        - reference-range
        - specimen-type
        - test-results
        - unit
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - critical-values-present
        - result-value
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - lab-name
        - ordering-provider-name
        - pathologist-name
        - patient-name
        - test-name
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - overall-status
        - status
  fields:
    - id: report-date
      name: report_date
      label: Report Date
      description: Date the laboratory report was finalized/issued, format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/report_date
    - id: collection-date
      name: collection_date
      label: Collection Date
      description: Date the specimen was collected from the patient, format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/collection_date
    - id: received-date
      name: received_date
      label: Received Date
      description: Date the specimen was received by the laboratory, format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/received_date
    - id: ordering-provider-name
      name: ordering_provider_name
      label: Ordering Provider Name
      description: Full name of the clinician who ordered the tests
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/ordering_provider_name
    - id: ordering-provider-npi
      name: ordering_provider_npi
      label: Ordering Provider Npi
      description: NPI of the ordering provider — 10-digit numeric; null if not printed on report
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/ordering_provider_npi
    - id: patient-name
      name: patient_name
      label: Patient Name
      description: Full name of the patient
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/patient_name
    - id: patient-dob
      name: patient_dob
      label: Patient Dob
      description: Patient date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/patient_dob
    - id: patient-mrn
      name: patient_mrn
      label: Patient Mrn
      description: Patient Medical Record Number assigned by the ordering facility
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/patient_mrn
    - id: lab-name
      name: lab_name
      label: Lab Name
      description: Name of the laboratory that performed the testing
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/lab_name
    - id: lab-clia-number
      name: lab_clia_number
      label: Lab Clia Number
      description: 'CLIA certificate number of the performing laboratory (format: two-digit state code + 7 digits,
        e.g., "45D0123456")'
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/lab_clia_number
    - id: specimen-type
      name: specimen_type
      label: Specimen Type
      description: "Type of biological specimen tested. One of: Blood | Urine | Swab | CSF | Stool | Sputum | Tissue
        | Pleural_Fluid | Serum | Plasma | Other"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/specimen_type
    - id: test-results
      name: test_results
      label: Test Results
      description: "Array of individual test result objects. For each test result line, extract:"
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/test_results
    - id: test-name
      name: test_name
      label: Test Name
      description: Name of the test as printed on the report (e.g., "Hemoglobin", "Glucose", "Creatinine")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/test_name
    - id: loinc-code
      name: loinc_code
      label: Loinc Code
      description: LOINC code if printed on report (e.g., "718-7"); null if not present
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/loinc_code
    - id: result-value
      name: result_value
      label: Result Value
      description: The result value as a string (e.g., "14.2", ">1000", "POSITIVE", "RESISTANT")
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/result_value
    - id: unit
      name: unit
      label: Unit
      description: Unit of measure (e.g., "g/dL", "mg/dL", "K/uL"). Null for qualitative results
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/unit
    - id: reference-range
      name: reference_range
      label: Reference Range
      description: Normal reference range as a string (e.g., "13.5-17.5", "<100", "Negative"). Null if not provided
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/reference_range
    - id: flag
      name: flag
      label: Flag
      description: "Abnormality flag. One of: H (High) | L (Low) | C (Critical) | null (Normal/Not flagged)"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/flag
    - id: status
      name: status
      label: Status
      description: "Result status. One of: Final | Preliminary | Corrected | Cancelled"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/status
    - id: overall-status
      name: overall_status
      label: Overall Status
      description: "Overall status of the lab report. One of: Final | Preliminary | Corrected | Cancelled"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/overall_status
    - id: critical-values-present
      name: critical_values_present
      label: Critical Values Present
      description: Boolean — true if ANY result in this report has a Critical (C) flag or is labeled "Critical
        Value" or "Panic Value" in the report
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/critical_values_present
    - id: pathologist-name
      name: pathologist_name
      label: Pathologist Name
      description: Name of the reviewing/verifying pathologist or laboratory director if signed on report. Null if
        not present
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/pathologist_name
    - id: clinical-notes
      name: clinical_notes
      label: Clinical Notes
      description: Free-text comments, interpretation notes, or footnotes appended to the report by the laboratory.
        Maximum 400 characters. Null if none
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/clinical_notes
  validationRules:
    - id: patient-mrn-present
      severity: error
      description: MRN is required to attach results to the right patient chart and downstream FHIR DiagnosticReport
        resource.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: patient_mrn
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: patient_mrn
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: patient_mrn IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(patient_mrn)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: lab-clia-number-format
      severity: warning
      description: CLIA certificate numbers should follow the standard two digits, D, seven digits format.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: lab_clia_number
          - op: matches
            left:
              field: lab_clia_number
            pattern: ^[0-9]{2}D[0-9]{7}$
      sourceExpression: lab_clia_number IS NULL OR lab_clia_number REGEXP '^[0-9]{2}D[0-9]{7}$'
      supported: true
    - id: test-results-not-empty
      severity: error
      description: A laboratory report without test result rows cannot support clinical review or quality reporting.
      rule:
        op: gt
        left:
          length: test_results
        right:
          value: 0
      sourceExpression: size(test_results) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: overall-status-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Report status must be one of the supported HL7/FHIR diagnostic report states.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: overall_status
            right:
              value: Final
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: overall_status
            right:
              value: Preliminary
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: overall_status
            right:
              value: Corrected
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: overall_status
            right:
              value: Cancelled
      sourceExpression: overall_status IN ('Final', 'Preliminary', 'Corrected', 'Cancelled')
      supported: true
    - id: avg-confidence-minimum
      severity: warning
      description: Low average confidence on lab reports can misstate critical values and must be routed to review.
      rule:
        op: gte
        left:
          field: avg_confidence
        right:
          value: 0.7
      sourceExpression: avg_confidence >= 0.70
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      patient_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Patient identity must be exact before results are posted to a chart.
      patient_mrn:
        minConfidence: 0.94
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: MRN is the primary chart-matching key for lab result ingestion.
      report_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Report date drives result timeliness and audit chronology.
      lab_clia_number:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: CLIA identifier is required for performing-lab auditability.
      test_results:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Result rows contain clinical values, flags, ranges, and statuses; errors can alter clinical
          interpretation.
      critical_values_present:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Critical value flags drive urgent notification workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-gemini-flash
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-dbrx-instruct
    maxTokens: 4096
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Lab reports often contain dense result tables, flags, footnotes, and fax artifacts. Gemini Flash is
      preferred for scanned or mixed-layout reports; DBRX Instruct is acceptable for digitally native text
      exports.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      report_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the laboratory report was finalized/issued, format YYYY-MM-DD
        format: date
      collection_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the specimen was collected from the patient, format YYYY-MM-DD
        format: date
      received_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the specimen was received by the laboratory, format YYYY-MM-DD
        format: date
      ordering_provider_name:
        type: string
        description: Full name of the clinician who ordered the tests
      ordering_provider_npi:
        type: string
        description: NPI of the ordering provider — 10-digit numeric; null if not printed on report
      patient_name:
        type: string
        description: Full name of the patient
      patient_dob:
        type: string
        description: Patient date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD
      patient_mrn:
        type: string
        description: Patient Medical Record Number assigned by the ordering facility
      lab_name:
        type: string
        description: Name of the laboratory that performed the testing
      lab_clia_number:
        type: string
        description: 'CLIA certificate number of the performing laboratory (format: two-digit state code + 7 digits,
          e.g., "45D0123456")'
      specimen_type:
        type: string
        description: "Type of biological specimen tested. One of: Blood | Urine | Swab | CSF | Stool | Sputum | Tissue
          | Pleural_Fluid | Serum | Plasma | Other"
      test_results:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: "Array of individual test result objects. For each test result line, extract:"
      test_name:
        type: string
        description: Name of the test as printed on the report (e.g., "Hemoglobin", "Glucose", "Creatinine")
      loinc_code:
        type: string
        description: LOINC code if printed on report (e.g., "718-7"); null if not present
      result_value:
        type: number
        description: The result value as a string (e.g., "14.2", ">1000", "POSITIVE", "RESISTANT")
      unit:
        type: string
        description: Unit of measure (e.g., "g/dL", "mg/dL", "K/uL"). Null for qualitative results
      reference_range:
        type: string
        description: Normal reference range as a string (e.g., "13.5-17.5", "<100", "Negative"). Null if not provided
      flag:
        type: string
        description: "Abnormality flag. One of: H (High) | L (Low) | C (Critical) | null (Normal/Not flagged)"
      status:
        type: string
        description: "Result status. One of: Final | Preliminary | Corrected | Cancelled"
      overall_status:
        type: string
        description: "Overall status of the lab report. One of: Final | Preliminary | Corrected | Cancelled"
      critical_values_present:
        type: boolean
        description: Boolean — true if ANY result in this report has a Critical (C) flag or is labeled "Critical
          Value" or "Panic Value" in the report
      pathologist_name:
        type: string
        description: Name of the reviewing/verifying pathologist or laboratory director if signed on report. Null if
          not present
      clinical_notes:
        type: string
        description: Free-text comments, interpretation notes, or footnotes appended to the report by the laboratory.
          Maximum 400 characters. Null if none
    required:
      - patient_mrn
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: imaging_diagnostics
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - patient_mrn
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - parties
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
